permissions.//: Read-only commands only. Every entry here must be incapable of changing a file, the database, the remote or the running server — an agent should never have to ask before looking at something. Anything that writes stays behind a prompt on purpose. The two PreToolUse guards below still run for these, because a hook decides before the permission does.

hooks.statusMessage: Checking the live database is untouched

PostToolUse.//: Prints what else has to move when a file in a documented chain is edited. A prompt, never a gate: it can only add context, and every failure path exits 0 printing nothing. Notes and reasoning in .claude/hooks/chain-notes.mjs.

SessionStart.//: Whether :3000 is up (which decides where a build may go) and how much of docs/improvement-plan.md section 7 is open. Fails open.
